subtitle: FROZEN LEGACY
intro: An inherited starship. A colony waiting for you.
citiesDescription: 60 stored city layouts · select a tile to inspect
worldsDescription: 18 stored world layouts · select a tile to inspect
helpBody: Explore the original ship outlines, city layouts and world maps. Use the arrows to change layouts, or select a point on the display. Keyboard: Enter selects; arrow keys move the selection; Escape returns.
helpScope: City view shows ordinary cities with their generated tile variants. Stored layouts remain available for every map. City walking, doors and ship exits are still being built.
surface: Inspect the layout. Press Enter to select, then use arrow keys to move the selection.
loadError: SunDog could not load. Check that all files are present and open it through a local HTTP server.
draftNote: Allocate your attributes, then board the ship. Drafts can be saved separately.
resetConfirm: Reset this character’s name and attributes? Saved drafts will remain.
loadConfirm: Replace the character you are editing with this draft?
invalidName: Enter a name of 1–15 characters, without control characters.
invalidDraft: Invalid or unsupported draft. Your character is unchanged.
duplicateName: Another slot already uses this name. Choose a different name.
storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. You can still export a JSON draft.
draftImported: Draft imported for editing. Save it to a slot to keep it.
walkNote: Ship walkthrough · Save to keep progress.
walkHint: Hold to walk · Arrow keys also move
walkStation: Station reached · Its controls are still in development.
walkPaused: Paused · Resume when you are ready.
walkControls: Hold a pointer or touch inside the ship to walk toward it. Release to stop. Focus the ship and use arrow keys to move. Escape returns to the preview.
walkScope: Open Inventory at stores or the locker to transfer items. Select carried food or rapidheal to use it. Each real second advances one game minute; hunger and fatigue change hourly. Inventory and help pause time. Sleep restores rest while time passes faster. Pause or wake at any time, except while exhausted. Use Saves to keep a ship checkpoint before reloading.
inventoryNote: Move items between slots. Carry food or rapidheal to use it.
storageHint: Walk to the locker or stores to transfer items. Stores are above the starting position; the locker is to its right.
inventoryEmpty: This slot is empty. Select an item first.
storageReached: {storage} reached · Open Inventory to transfer items.
inventoryUseHint: {item} → Move it or use it below.
inventoryUseFull: {item} · Already full; using it still consumes it.
itemUsedAtFull: Item consumed. Condition was already full.
sleepHint: Time passes faster while sleeping. Nourishment still falls. Wake when ready.
deathScope: This walkthrough has ended. Load a checkpoint through Saves, or restart with the initial supplies and condition.
checkpointScope: Save this ship walkthrough. Character drafts and campaigns are separate.
checkpointHint: Save while awake. Loading resumes paused.
checkpointLoadOnly: Load a checkpoint or import one to continue.

invalidCheckpoint: Invalid or incompatible ship checkpoint. Nothing was replaced.

checkpointStorageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. You can still import or export JSON.
campaignLaunchScope: Explore your ship, inspect equipment, manage supplies and rest. Travel and trade are still in development.
campaignSeedHint: Leave blank for a new world, or reuse a saved seed.

campaignDeath: This session has ended. Load a saved game, or return to create a character.
campaignControls: Move with arrow keys or a held pointer/touch. Enter uses doors or city markers. Escape leaves services or returns to the title.
campaignPlayScope: Use Navigation at pilotage to launch, select a world or warp point, charge a jump, and land. Trade and service the ship in ordinary cities. Park your pod to explore on foot. Save during travel.

equipmentUnavailable: This equipment is not accessible here.
